title: Coefficient of a punctured full set
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and let $i$ be a coordinate in $ br^n$; over the field with two elements, consider the Boolean function that equals $1$ exactly at the zero vector and the all-ones vector. Its algebraic normal form coefficient indexed by all coordinates except $i$ is $1$.
